verdict.rationale: Bento is an observability platform rather than an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. Its quickstart says supported coding agents load Bento's docs over MCP, which shows some official MCP connection. The evidence describes only documentation access, not an MCP server exposing Bento's traces, signals, issues or other product operations. missing for 10: an MCP server exposing product data and actions, endpoint and setup documentation, tool listing, auth details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Each tool installs the skill the same way, then loads the docs over MCP.
Paste this into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, or Windsurf. It installs Bento’s Agent Skills and hands the agent the full integration playbook
